title: Selection of a housekeeping miRNA to normalize qRT-PCR data
author: Barbara Rizzacasa
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.zpxf5pn
materials: Identifcation of a "housekeeping" microRNA among the 84 circulating of the Human Serum & Plasma miScript miRNA PCR Array (MIHS-106ZA, QIAGEN):

steps.title: Evaluate miRNA expression levels
steps.instruction: Evaluate the expression level of the candidate miRNA in all enrolled samples using the comparative Ct method quantification (2-ΔCt method).

steps.title: Select internal control miRNA
steps.instruction: Identify a housekeeping miRNA (e.g., miR-15b-5p) that shows no significant differences in expression levels among the study groups (e.g., CAD, AMI_T0, and AMI_T1 patients) to serve as the internal control.
